props.name: values
props.description: The matrix to cluster: one row per item, one column per measurement.

props.name: columns
props.description: Column names. When given, the matrix is drawn as a heatmap in leaf order.

props.name: linkage
props.description: How the distance between two clusters is measured.

props.name: distance
props.description: How the distance between two rows is measured. Correlation groups rows by shape, not size.

props.name: defaultCut
props.description: Cut height when uncontrolled. Defaults to 60% of the tallest merge.

props.name: showHeatmap
props.description: Draw the reordered matrix beside the tree.

props.name: rowHeight
props.description: Height of each leaf row in pixels.
